name: NOCDURNA pivotal program
question: Does low-dose desmopressin orally disintegrating tablet reduce nocturnal voids and increase 33% responders versus placebo in men and women with nocturia?

design.population: Separate trials randomized 395 men and 268 women with at least two nocturnal voids nightly; 84%–89% of men and 88%–89% of women in the full analysis sets had nocturnal polyuria at baseline.
design.description: Two multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trials; the men’s study used hierarchical two-sided 5% testing at 75 μg before 50 μg.
design.locator: Men full text, Figure 1, Table 1 and Statistical Analysis, pp 966–968; women full text, Figure 1 and Table 1, pp 960–961

verdictNote: Both coprimary endpoints met the prespecified superiority test at each tested dose.
takeaway: In three-month trials of adults with nocturia, desmopressin ODT 50 or 75 μg in men and 25 μg in women reduced voids and increased 33% response odds versus placebo; sodium below 130 mmol/L occurred in 2, 9, and 3 treated patients, respectively.

harms.label: Serum sodium below 130 mmol/L
harms.note: Safety analysis set; the two men at 50 μg were aged 74 and 79 years; 9/11 affected men were at least 65 years old; all recovered to at least 130 mmol/L.

harms.label: Serum sodium 125 mmol/L or less
harms.note: Safety analysis set; these events are included in the below-130 mmol/L counts.

harms.label: Any treatment-emergent adverse event
harms.note: Safety analysis set; no Clavien-Dindo grades reported.

harms.label: Serious adverse event

delivery.label: Men's trial dosing
delivery.value: Desmopressin ODT 50 μg or 75 μg versus placebo once nightly for three months, taken one hour before bedtime; patients were instructed to empty the bladder before bed and drink only to satisfy thirst.
delivery.locator: Full text, Study Design and Procedures, p 966

delivery.label: Men’s trial adherence and completion
delivery.value: 98% of the 385-man full analysis set took more than 80% of planned doses; 327/395 randomized men (83%) completed the three-month double-blind treatment.
delivery.locator: Full text, Figure 1 and Results, pp 966, 969
